thread:
sasha (security): Heads-up: infra wants to deprecate SSE-C bucket uploads in favor of CMEK-backed SSE-KMS for all nightly DB backups. We need to plan RBAC + audit log changes before rolling this out.

maria (encops): +1. Are we requiring HSM-protected keys (HSM-wrapped CMEK) for tenant-level backups or just account-level CMEK?

jay (infra): Proposal was account-level CMEK initially, but compliance asked for HSM for regulated tenants. We can gate via bucket tags.

tim (dbops): Main concerns: restore path must keep working when CMEK grants are missing (service account rotation, cross-account restores). Need a fallback plan.

sasha (security): Agreed. Core asks: 1) RBAC change doc for uploader role (no SSE-C allowed) 2) KMS grant flow for backup-uploader SA with TTL and audited grant issuance 3) migration plan for existing SSE-C objects 4) runbook update for restore failures + telemetry.

maria (encops): For (2) I suggest ephemeral KMS grants using KMS:Decrypt with condition on resource name + tag. Short TTL grants issued by encops service. That avoids long-lived grants.

tim (dbops): How will this affect restores for archived snapshots located in cold storage? We currently have a path where ops does a manual SSE-C decrypt with a key in vault. If we move to CMEK HSM, that manual path disappears. Need automated recovery with escrow.

jay (infra): We can add an escrow flow: encrypted metadata points to keystore-id. Restore job calls encops service which requests a short-lived decrypt grant from KMS. Encops will log grant issuance and the requestor identity.

sasha (security): Sounds good. Two security questions: a) audit logs - are our current KMS logs capturing grant issuance metadata + requester? b) RBAC - do we need a new IAM role for encops to issue grants on behalf of dbops?

maria (encops): a) Cloud KMS audit logs include CryptoKeyDecrypted and IAM policy_set events, but not our custom grant annotations. We'll emit an internal audit event when we issue ephemeral grants. b) Yes, create role roles/encops.grantIssuer with a narrow iam:GrantDelegate scope.

tim (dbops): Migration plan suggestion: run a sweep that downloads SSE-C encrypted objects, re-encrypts server-side with SSE-KMS + CMEK, uploads with original names, and then verify checksums. For large datasets do incremental windowed copy.

jay (infra): Implementation note: use parallelized copy job that respects bucket tags. Sample command snippet:
```
# pseudo: copy from SSE-C -> SSE-KMS
gsutil -m cp -r -o 'GSUtil:encryption=KMS' 
  -o 'Boto:encryption_kms_key_name=projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...' 
  gs://old-sse-c-bucket/** gs://cmek-bucket/
```
Will need to supply SSE-C key material to the job; prefer running in a short-lived VM with access to secure temp storage.

sasha (security): We must update the uploader IAM docs to forbid SSE-C headers. Also add an automated detector for new SSE-C uploads (alert to #eng-security).

maria (encops): I'll prototype ephemeral grant issuance + logging this week. Quick TODOs: create role proposal, audit log query to validate grants, and migration canary on a staging tenant.

tim (dbops): I'll scope the restore runbook changes and prepare test snapshots for the canary.

jay (infra): I'll draft the bucket tag enforcement policy and a small lambda to reject SSE-C uploads at edge (403).

encops-bot: Deploy pipeline: CI job "encops/grant-service" scheduled, build started (job id: 3429). :gear:

sasha (security): Great. Can we have a short review meeting tomorrow 10am PT? If so I'll add an agenda: RBAC changes, grant audit trail, migration canary, rollback triggers.

maria (encops): Works for me.

tim (dbops): 10am ok.

jay (infra): Yup.

sasha (security): Thanks everyone. I'll drop a draft RBAC PR and runbook link in this thread before EOD.
